1dc3ebf9-c86c-431c-bcca-5e35ac124f28.title: Baekjakga ui Mangnani ga Doeeotda
1dc3ebf9-c86c-431c-bcca-5e35ac124f28.description:
Saat membuka mata, aku sudah berada di dalam dunia novel.
Tidak hanya itu, aku masuk ke dalam tubuh seorang tuan muda dari keluarga Count yang terkenal sebagai pembuat onar.
Tetapi, aku tidak bisa menjadi seorang pembuat onar begitu saja kan?

85b4d2f6-b4bc-42ba-b478-7ecde3b706e1.title: Saving the Villain from the Heroine
85b4d2f6-b4bc-42ba-b478-7ecde3b706e1.altTitle: Saving the Villain Who Was Abandoned by the Female Lead
85b4d2f6-b4bc-42ba-b478-7ecde3b706e1.description:
Sielle is an ordinary handmaid working for the Grand Duke Ferzei Yekarte. The thing is… she knows he's a villain of a story she read in her previous life on Earth.

With her prescience, she managed to foil an assassination attempt on her master, only to be framed for the crime! Worse yet, when she drank the poisoned wine to prove her innocence, she turns into a little girl...

And now the Grand Duke wants to ship her off to a notorious family of assassins? Will she manage to survive through all this, even if she knows how it will all end?"

c9ac4d19-8735-46e2-ae79-195fca78c39e.title: Kyuudaiten Demo Seishun Wo!
c9ac4d19-8735-46e2-ae79-195fca78c39e.altTitle: Even Repeaters Want to Enjoy Youth
c9ac4d19-8735-46e2-ae79-195fca78c39e.description: Chiharu Hiiragi repeated a year and is struggling to fit in with his class. While taking remedial chemistry in the infirmary, the person sitting next to him turns out to be a super shy classmate covered in a bedsheet. Wearing a ghost-like sheet, her face is hidden, and her conversations are awkward. Yet, for some reason, being with her feels comforting. Things about their age, about school, and the secrets they can't quite put into words... As they slowly share more conversations, their time after school begins to change. A slightly awkward, a little off-beat, passing-grade and clumsy after-school youth comedy starting from the infirmary, begins!

b39f7358-e142-4465-9682-56e3af4e15c1.title: Ezuke Shita Toroware no Kishi no xx ga Tsuyosugite Muri Desu
b39f7358-e142-4465-9682-56e3af4e15c1.altTitle: Ksatria Tawanan yang Ku beri Makan punya XX Kuat
b39f7358-e142-4465-9682-56e3af4e15c1.description: By chance, Toa accesses a prison in another world and meets a cursed knight whose sexual desire increases many times when his appetite is satisfied. Unaware of this, Toa couldn't leave the knight in front of him, who was on the verge of starvation, and forced him to eat udon, but he was suddenly pushed down by the knight in heat!?A different world BL with a mumbling love and appetite begins!

d6cdf319-8bde-4674-9473-54d8001a9601.title: Kiomaru the Blacksmith
d6cdf319-8bde-4674-9473-54d8001a9601.description: Since his childhood, Kiomaru has been formed by master Sadamitsu of the Gassan forge so that he could later become a specialist in sword making. One day, when he learns of the brutal death of a young man to which he sold his first sword, he realize his own inexperience and decides to adopt a new attitude by following an exacting training. After avenging the young man, he continues his training, but one day, his master reveal to him an unbelievable secret: 18 years ago, meteorites nicknamed "Steel of the stars" fell from the sky on a dark mountain. Since that day, it seems the wheel of destiny enforced itself.

chapters.title: Iron Hammered a Hundred Thousand Times

fccf8436-e642-4a5e-8c62-60eb99aea92e.title: Kawaisou ni ne, Genki-kun
fccf8436-e642-4a5e-8c62-60eb99aea92e.description:
Genki Hirota has what others would call a peculiar fetish. Knowing the abnormality of it, he had intended on giving up on love, however, his feelings towards his classmate, Yachimidori, are smoldering? To cope, he draws out painful scenarios in which a character made in her image always suffers, however, when his comics get discovered by the class idol, Sagisawa, he gets pulled along by her whims.
___
**Alt Official Raw:** [Tonari no Young Jump](https://tonarinoyj.jp/episode/10834108156646927837)

chapters.title: Even Though You are Such a Pervert

c323bce7-f210-4811-9019-069e67d2588f.title: Jigu ui Juin eun Goyangida
c323bce7-f210-4811-9019-069e67d2588f.description:
Though Chichi the cat looks very cute, she has one goal: eradicate humanity and take over the world! She decides to recruit comrades to aid her in her quest, but it looks like world conquest won't be that easy?! 

Follow the adventures of Chichi the tyrant, Dunno the doggo who loves humans, and Kaiser Kang Taeshik, the hard-boiled wild hamster, as they face many hardships on their path to absolute dominion!

4a651fa9-4309-48cf-9203-86b7ddf3d24b.title: Made in Abyss Official Anthology
4a651fa9-4309-48cf-9203-86b7ddf3d24b.altTitle: メイドインアビス公式アンソロジー
4a651fa9-4309-48cf-9203-86b7ddf3d24b.description:
Made in Abyss: Official Anthology is a compendium of short comics set in the same world and with the same characters from Made in Abyss.  
It's a parallel series from the same publisher, Takeshobo, and with Akihito Tsukushi's blessing, that gathers the work of multiple guest professional artists to tell non-canon stories, with some of them being serious, while others are totally silly or humorous.   
It has been published on Webcomic Gamma, alongside with Made in Abyss, since 2017.

33175c80-1f03-4fa6-b164-71f1fcb744e8.title: Everyday Host
33175c80-1f03-4fa6-b164-71f1fcb744e8.description: Salesman Sekiguchi, who works for a life insurance company, makes a rash decision and switches careers to become a host at a nightclub. At Club One, he finds himself surrounded by an eccentric cast: a "little brother" type host with 20 years of experience, a former idol who specializes in romance-driven sales, a hardcore mobile game addict with a tough-guy attitude, and more. Though Sekiguchi thinks, "This is no job for a sane person." He uses his insurance sales skills to attract customers, plunging headfirst into a wild and outrageous host life.

995c1c87-db62-4575-9300-b8d47363a3b1.title: Godo
995c1c87-db62-4575-9300-b8d47363a3b1.description:
From the mind of Noboru Miyama comes Godo! 
An adventure set in a mysterious and weird world with influences from Norse mythology.

"Put an end to this cursed world! That is your fate!". 
An alchemist by the name of Godo whose father was charged with theft must seek revenge for his father 
and his own freedom as he participates in the fighting festival known as Valhalla.
